build_multi_crop_wrapper: build a MultiCropWrapper that runs a backbone and head on multiple crop resolutions
create_lars_optimizer: create a LARS optimizer with weight decay and adaptive learning rate for training
run_cosine_scheduler: run a cosine annealing scheduler with optional warmup for learning rate or weight decay
test_accuracy: test the accuracy function to compute top-k accuracy for classification predictions
build_metric_logger: build a MetricLogger to track smoothed training metrics and log them at intervals
